Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Loder <q960...@musgrave.cqu.edu.au> wrote:
> Arika's special ability, does it affect locquipment?

Yes. Each Locquipment counts as a location while in play.

> Haven Uncovered VS Secure Haven. Whats the go here?

No go. Directed actions cannot be taken against the
vampire whose haven is secured. This includes Bum's
Rush and the "enter combat" actions specified by Haven
Uncovered and Contract.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Loder <q960...@musgrave.cqu.edu.au> wrote:
> The ability of Ambrosius, the Ferryman to place a retainer
> from the ash heap on a ready vampire.
> Do any of the requirements of the retainer (ie, requires a
> certain clan or discipline) apply in this case? Say I used
> Ambrosius to move a Dog Pack (requiring Gangrel) onto a
> Giovanni vampire, is this OK?

Yes. Ambrosius is not "employing" the retainer - he's just moving
the retainer card from the ash heap to a vampire you control.
So he doesn't have to meet the requirements of employing the
retainer.



Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <9307004...@www.remarq.com>, Andrew Loder
<q960...@musgrave.cqu.edu.au> writes

>Arika's special ability, does it affect locquipment?

Locquipment is a location when in play so, yes, it does.

>
>Haven Uncovered VS Secure Haven. Whats the go here?

Secure Haven means no (D) actions at the vampire with it on. Haven
Uncovered (not forgetting you'd have to pay 1 pool to put it on in the
first place, if the Secure HAven was already down) allows a (D) action
at the vampire to rush it, but that gets blocked by the secure haven.

To get round it, you have to either burn or move the Secure Haven first
- an Arson would be directed at the Haven, not the vampire, so would get
through.
